title: Insurance Claim Services Deductible: Assessment, Due Date, Installments and Tender
content:
**Clause.** The claim file must be in opened, estimate submitted, approved or settled status when a deductible line is posted. On arrangements where the carrier pays the company net of the deductible, the full per-occurrence deductible from the policy declarations is assessed once when the file opens and collected from the insured; on arrangements where the carrier pays the insured, no deductible is assessed on the file because the insured pays the company's invoices in full. The deductible is due within the tier's deductible due days counted in calendar days from the collection point: the earliest date on which a water, fire, mold or contents job of the file was authorized or a rebuild contract of the file was signed when the collection point is at authorization, or the earliest final invoice date among the mitigation jobs and rebuild contract of the file when it is at final invoice. It may be paid in up to the tier's maximum number of installments, numbered from 1, and by card only on tiers that accept cards. The company never waives, absorbs, discounts or rebates a deductible, and several states, Texas among them (Insurance Code Chapter 707), prohibit a contractor from doing so; a customer asking for that is told it is not available. A deductible payment larger than the remaining deductible due is not accepted for the excess.

This Insurance Claim Services clause governs both the assessment of the deductible and every deductible payment. Whether the company collects, the collection point, the due days, the installment maximum and card acceptance are each tier's own figures.

## Status condition

The claim file's status on the system record decides: a deductible line (an assessment or a payment) may be posted while the file is opened, estimate submitted, approved or settled, and not while it is closed, denied or withdrawn.

## When the deductible is assessed

| Arrangement type | Deductible on the file |
|---|---|
| the carrier pays the company net of the deductible | the full per-occurrence deductible from the policy declarations, assessed once when the file opens |
| the carrier pays the insured | none assessed |

## The due date

| Collection point | Clock starts on | Due by |
|---|---|---|
| at authorization | the earliest date on which a water, fire, mold or contents job of the file was authorized or a rebuild contract of the file was signed | that date plus the tier's due days, in calendar days |
| at final invoice | the earliest final invoice date among the mitigation jobs and rebuild contract of the file | that date plus the tier's due days, in calendar days |

*Hypothetical:* on a tier collecting at authorization with 10 due days, where the file's contents job was authorized on 4 May and its water job on 6 May, the clock starts on 4 May and the deductible is due by 14 May.

## Paying it

- Installments are numbered from 1 and may not exceed the tier's maximum.
- A card is accepted only on tiers that accept cards.
- A payment above the remaining deductible due is not accepted for the excess: with 300.00 remaining, a 450.00 tender is accepted only for 300.00.
- The deductible is never waived, absorbed, discounted or rebated; a customer who asks is told it is not available.
